summary: terminal_full.py: CLI requires --repository-root, --plan-dir, --out; loads implementation contract and referenced command registry; executes plan tools/terminal_validation.py in repository root with captured UTF-8 output; validates nonzero terminal exit and all slice red/green command IDs exist in registry; emits quick-dev-implementation-complete.v1 receipt with plan_id, predicate implementation-complete, pass/fail, failures, contract/registry hashes, terminal command ID, validated IDs, authorization only on pass, lifecycle_transition none, stdout SHA-256; on pass publishes immutable/idempotent canonical receipt under repair/round-1, uses contract-hash successor on conflicting content; always writes --out and prints JSON; exits 0 pass, 1 fail; ambiguity: terminal validator stdout is hashed but its content is not structurally inspected.
